svg.aria-label: K_t is the body of work on one research question published before cutoff t. Human proposals from the next 31 days build on the same K_t; an AI proposal generated at t can only draw on K_t. A pairwise ranker compares two human proposals and is checked against later citations (calibration), then compares the AI proposal with every human proposal in the cohort (ideation).
